info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List Application Institutions-spec
info.description: The List Application Institutions API allows users to retrieve a list of institutions associated with a specific application identified by its application ID. This functionality is essential for businesses looking to manage application workflows, facilitate compliance checks, or gather institution-specific data essential for decision-making. The API primarily serves developers and integrations that require seamless access to institution-related information for a given application. Typical use cases include data aggregation, reporting, and enhancing user interfaces in financial or administrative systems.

get.summary: Retrieve institutions associated with resource RES-100045.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch a list of institutions linked to the specified resource, RES-100045. It provides detailed information about the institutions, including their attributes and associations.
